minutes_text:
Arts Commission

  Inglewood, California
  May 15, 2024

A meeting of the Inglewood Arts Commission was convened on May 15, 2024.
Commissioner Lesure called the meeting to order at 6:30 p.m. followed by the flag salute.

Stephanie Maldonado announced the presence of a quorum as follows:

  Present: Commissioner Aletha Metcalf ‐ District 1, Commissioner Olivia Alvitre ‐
  District 2, Commissioner Phyllis Battle ‐ District 3, Commissioner Vicki Perryman-
  Banks - District 4, Commissioner Jacques Lesure - Commissioner at Large

  Absent: None

City Personnel present were as follows:

  Thomas Uwal  Parks, Recreation, and Community Services Director
  Helen Lessick  Public Art Consultant
  Stephanie Maldonado  Senior Management Assistant

PUBLIC COMMENTS. None

MINUTES. None

VERBAL REPORTS-Public Art‐Related Projects.
  a. Community Information Guide Public Art Article - one (1) page of Public Art will
  feature in quarterly guide.
  b. Creative House Utility Box Update - Creative House Gallery Artists’ Reception and
  Community Event will be held on June 29, 2024 at 4 p.m. - 6 p.m. at 122 N. Market
  Street Inglewood, 90301. Visit www.thecreativehouse.org for more information.
  c. Public Art Consulting Update - April 18: 6th Annual Infraday in California; May 1:
  LA 28 Cultural Planning for Santa Monica which is a venue city for LA 28 games;
  Art X will be held in Flagstaff, AZ.

PUBLIC COMMENTS. Shuree Danyell, CEP of 4KMORE Creative would like to provide jobs
for 4,000 black and brown creators by 2025. The jobs will include video and audio
production along with branding.

  1
   Arts Commission

COMMISSIONERS’ COMMENTS/INITIATIVES/ART CALENDAR.
Commissioner Banks made a motion to reschedule the next Arts Commission meeting
scheduled for June 19th to June 26th due to the Juneteenth Holiday. Commissioner Lesure
seconded and the motion as carried by the following roll call vote:
Ayes: Commissioners Metcalf, Alvitre, Battle, Banks and Lesure.
Noes: None

There being no further business to be presented, Commissioner Lesure declared the
meeting adjourned, at 7:03 p.m.
